name: WWCE Community Fund
summary: Small grants for Wiltshire community and voluntary groups whose projects support wildlife conservation, climate mitigation, carbon reduction or fuel poverty relief, with a panel deciding awards several times a year.

calls.label: Community Fund applications
calls.note: Panel meets three times a year; 2027 meeting dates not yet confirmed

status.quote: The Community Fund is currently open for applications!

administered_by.quote: The Community Fund is managed by a Community Fund Panel and administered by Wiltshire Wildlife Trust.

applicant_types.quote: Grants have been allocated to a range of community and voluntary group across Wiltshire

geography.quote: To be considered for funding, the objectives of your Wiltshire-based project should reflect WWCE's own aims.

access.quote: Projects seeking up to £5000 can apply using our grant application form

window.quote: Small grant applications can be made throughout the year.
